name: Mushrooms
overview: Scripture teaches that God is the Creator of all things, including the earth and its vegetation, which He provided for the sustenance of humanity and animals alike (Genesis 1:1, 1:29-30). While the Bible does not explicitly mention mushrooms, it affirms that God gave every herb and plant yielding seed as food for mankind and creatures (Genesis 1:29-30). After the Flood, God expanded this provision to include all moving creatures for food, with the clear command to avoid consuming blood (Genesis 9:3-4). The mention of mandrakes, a plant found in the field, illustrates the recognition of various plants during biblical times (Genesis 30:14). Thus, the biblical perspective emphasizes God's sovereign provision of natural resources for nourishment, under His established boundaries.
